usage: mcp-firewall-connect <slug>

Proxies stdio to an MCP Firewall hub over Streamable HTTP.

Options:
  -v, --version   print the version and exit
  -h, --help      print this help and exit

Environment:
  MCP_FIREWALL_TOKEN   hub bearer token (falls back to the shim token file)
  MCP_FIREWALL_PORT    daemon port (default 7920)
  MCP_FIREWALL_HOME    state directory override
